yourDataCard.title: Export and deletion
yourDataCard.description: Your own data is a button. An organisation-wide export or deletion is a request we answer within one month, because it needs a platform administrator to run.
yourDataCard.deletionNote: Deleting your account anonymises what booking records must retain, then removes the account.
